text:
sara: Heads-up — notify-proxy is returning 504s and outbound pages to PagerDuty haven't been delivered for ~12m. PD shows webhooks queued but failing. Anyone oncall?

ops-bot: Automation alert: notify-proxy error rate spike (504) in us-west-2; triggered channel. :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Webhook delivery error summary: integration=int_abc123, status=504, attempts=3, last_response="upstream read timeout"

alex: I'm looking. Initial hypothesis: upstream (notify-worker) stuck on a retry loop, causing proxy backpressure. Pulling logs now. 

jin: Confirming from my end — I can reproduce 504s with a simple curl. Response body is empty, upstream timeout.

maria: Quick mitigation idea: switch PD integration to the sms-fallback connector (manual) for high-sev rules until we fix. We can flip the PD integration in the UI. Thoughts?

alex: Agreed. I'll coordinate manual fallback. @oncall-rotation please confirm the on-call owner for the next 30m so we can escalate if manual pages are missed.

oncall-rotation: Oncall is @maria for the next 1h. I've notified her.

alex: Steps I'm doing:
1) spin a new notify-worker pod with fresh env to break any stuck state
2) increase proxy read_timeout to 60s temporarily
3) enable manual sms-fallback for PD rules (maria)

sara: Noted. Customer impact: ops-alerts team reports two customers (acct: acme-corp, acct: beta-inc) opened support tickets saying they didn't get high-priority pages. Marking as P1 until manual fallback confirmed.

alex: Executed step 1 and 2. New worker is up (pod/notify-worker-7f9d). Proxy read_timeout increased. Re-testing webhooks now.

jin: After restart I'm seeing webhooks return 200 again for small batches, but bulk deliveries still have intermittent 504s. Example curl response: 
```
POST /v1/webhook  HTTP/1.1
Host: notify-proxy.internal
User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
Content-Type: application/json

HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
Connection: keep-alive
```

maria: I flipped the PD rules to sms-fallback and sent a test page to acme-corp — they confirmed delivery via SMS. Manual pages active.

alex: Good. I'll tail logs for the next 15m and rollback the read_timeout change if we see regressions. Also opening a PD incident with integration logs and sample webhook payloads.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD-INC-3821 (notify-proxy webhook failures) — assigned to Platform Eng.

ops-bot: Temporary mitigation in place: manual SMS fallback enabled for high-sev rules. Automation still failing for webhooks; continuing investigation.

jin: Root cause suspect: a bug in the notify-worker retry backoff where a single long-running delivery blocks the worker threadpool under heavy concurrency. I see repeated stack traces referencing queue.consume -> deliverWebhook -> httpClient.pool.acquire.

alex: If that holds, long-term fix: make deliveries per-tenant async (non-blocking) and enforce per-tenant concurrency caps. Short-term: scale out worker pool and add circuit-breaker to skip stuck deliveries. I'll draft an RFC after immediate mitigation.

sara: Customer comms: ops -> please log affected accounts and reach out to their CSMs with an explanation + remediation. Keep me posted on any SLA breach risk.

maria: Affected accounts: acme-corp, beta-inc, gamma-systems (alerts failed between 18:42-18:54 UTC). CSMs notified.

alex: Observability note: adding a new metric for webhook queue latency and per-integration failure ratio. Will be part of postmortem.

(20 min later)

alex: All quiet on my end. Webhook success rates back to normal (~99.8%). Manual fallback still on for 30m to be safe.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-3821 updated: status=monitoring, priority=P1, alert_count=37.

jin: I've applied a short-term patch to worker that prevents blocking on one tenant. Patch id: pr/5212. Deploying to canary now.

sara: Great. Action items before we close:
- alex: confirm long-term plan RFC + timeline (1wk draft)
- jin: monitor canary + promote if stable
- ops: customer comms + SLA check
- infra: add auto-scale rule for notify-worker when queue depth > 500

maria: All actioned items acknowledged. I'll keep manual fallback until we validate canary for 60m, then revert.

(60m later)

alex: Canary looks good, promoting patch. Turning off manual sms-fallback in 10m and watching PD deliveries.

maria: Manual fallback turned off. Test pages delivered via webhook successfully.

ops-bot: Automation metrics recovered. Error rate back to baseline.

sara: Closing incident thread for now — postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Please add logs/snippets to the PM. If delivery regressions reappear, reopen with thread_ts 1765439991. :white_check_mark:
